answer: Sybil problem: one operator can mint many keys and pack grade seats. Mechanism: each grader locks a 0.25-POA opal stake into vertex commitment H(pubkey||epoch_seed) for 48h; only knoll-ranked work-weight ≥0.04 (top 15 by final attestations) may sit, and payout uses the median score. Cost: clones burn stake plus work credits on double-nullifier. Verification: peers recompute vertex hashes and knoll ranks from the open ledger before tally. Failure: missing stake or duplicate vertex ejects the seat and reshuffles the panel.
